title: Saturday Decision
description: An AI GM agent's Saturday roster-run output (PLAN.md §4 'Saturday AM — Roster run'): FAAB waiver claims, drops, an optional outgoing trade offer, and a reply to this week's owner note.

claims.description: FAAB waiver claims, in priority order (highest priority first); processed by scripts/faab.py.

drop.description: Roster player id to drop to make room, or null if none is needed.

bid.description: FAAB bid in whole dollars, 0 <= bid <= remaining budget ($100/season).

drops.description: Player ids to drop outright (no corresponding add).

trade_offer.description: Optional outgoing trade offer; shaped like trade-offer.json ({to_team, out, in, message?}). Omit if not offering a trade this week (max one outgoing offer per team per week).

note_reply.description: In-character reply to the owner's note for this team this week (may be empty string if no note was left).
